title: Understanding MSE Minimization
text: When trying to minimize the Mean Squared Error (MSE) using a constant model, think about how the model's prediction should relate to the target values. What statistical measure best represents the central tendency of a dataset?

title: Exploring Central Tendency
text: Which of the following measures of central tendency is most appropriate for minimizing the MSE in a constant model?

title: Why the Mean?
text: The mean is the value that minimizes the sum of squared deviations from itself. This property makes it the optimal choice for minimizing MSE when using a constant model. Consider how each data point's deviation from the mean contributes to the overall error.
